column2: The workstation has enough memory for this dataset.

column2: The laptop gets hot during compilation.

column4: Which tool generated the report?

column3: 这个实用工具会清理旧日志文件。
column4: Install the command-line utility for local testing.

column2: The basic functionality works without an account.
column3: 不注册账户也能使用基本功能。
column4: This change adds export functionality to the dashboard.
column5: 这次改动给仪表板加了导出功能。

column2: The new client is compatible with the old server.
column3: 新客户端与旧服务器兼容。
column4: Is this file format compatible with the mobile app?
column5: 这个文件格式与移动应用兼容吗？

column2: The update needs a compatibility test on older devices.
column3: 这次更新需要在旧设备上做兼容性测试。
column4: We kept the old field name for compatibility.
column5: 为了兼容，我们保留了旧字段名。

column2: The portable build runs from a USB drive.
column3: 这个便携版本可以从移动存储设备运行。
column4: Keep this code portable across operating systems.
column5: 让这段代码能在不同操作系统之间移植。

column2: The system-specific call limits portability.
column3: 这个系统专用调用限制了可移植性。
column4: Test portability by building on a second platform.
column5: 在另一个平台上构建，测试可移植性。

column2: The browser extension reads the current page title.
column3: 这个浏览器扩展会读取当前页面标题。
column4: The file extension does not prove its actual format.
column5: 文件扩展名不能证明实际格式。

column2: We can extend the parser to support comments.
column3: 我们可以扩展解析器，让它支持注释。
column4: Does this change extend the response schema?
column5: 这个改动会扩展响应结构吗？

column2: The modular design lets us replace the payment provider.
column3: 模块化设计让我们能替换支付服务商。
column4: Keep the test helpers modular instead of building one large utility.
column5: 让测试辅助代码保持模块化，不要堆成一个大工具。

column2: The package supports more than one platform.
column3: 这个软件包支持多个平台。
column4: Which platform should we test first?
column5: 我们应该先测试哪个平台？

column2: Record the measurement with its unit.
column3: 记录测量值时带上单位。
column4: Repeat the measurement after the system warms up.
column5: 系统预热后，再测量一次。

column2: The change needs a measurable performance goal.
column3: 这个改动需要一个可量化的性能目标。
column4: We saw a measurable drop in startup time.
column5: 启动时间出现了可测量的下降。

column2: The audit log records changes to account permissions.
column3: 审计日志会记录账户权限的变更。
column4: Schedule an audit of our third-party dependencies.
column5: 安排一次第三方依赖审计。

column2: The ledger keeps a record of each balance change.
column3: 账本会记录每一次余额变化。
column4: Compare the ledger entry with the payment receipt.
column5: 把账本记录与支付回执进行比较。

column2: The date field accepts year, month, and day.
column3: 日期字段接受年、月、日。
column4: Display the date using the user's locale.
column5: 按用户的地区格式显示日期。

column2: The time is stored separately from the date.
column3: 时间与日期分开存储。
column4: We need time to investigate this failure.
column5: 我们需要时间调查这个故障。

column2: The calendar marks days with completed lessons.
column3: 日历会标出完成学习的日期。
column4: Can users move through the calendar with arrow keys?
column5: 用户能用方向键在日历中移动吗？

column2: Use a monotonic clock to measure elapsed time.
column3: 用单调时钟测量经过的时间。
column4: The server clock is five minutes behind.
column5: 服务器时钟慢了五分钟。

column2: Cancel the timer when the component is removed.
column3: 组件移除时取消计时器。
column4: The timer may fire late when the event loop is busy.
column5: 事件循环繁忙时，计时器可能晚些触发。

column2: Add a short delay before retrying the request.
column3: 重试请求前加一个短暂延迟。
column4: The delay is visible on slower phones.
column5: 这个延迟在较慢的手机上很明显。

column2: The polling interval is thirty seconds.
column3: 轮询间隔是三十秒。
column4: Increase the interval when the page is hidden.
column5: 页面隐藏时延长间隔。

column2: The duration includes time spent waiting for the database.
column3: 这个持续时间包含等待数据库的时间。
column4: Show the recording duration beside the stop button.
column5: 在停止按钮旁显示录制时长。

column2: Each reporting period begins at midnight UTC.
column3: 每个报告周期从协调世界时午夜开始。
column4: The sampling period must be shorter for this signal.
column5: 这个信号需要更短的采样周期。

column2: The counter updates once every second.
column3: 计数器每秒更新一次。
column4: Wait one second before trying the connection again.
column5: 等待一秒再尝试连接。

column2: The job usually completes in under a minute.
column3: 这个任务通常不到一分钟就能完成。
column4: We group these events by minute.
column5: 我们按分钟对这些事件分组。

column2: The backup runs once an hour.
column3: 备份每小时运行一次。
column4: Show the hour in the user's local time zone.
column5: 按用户本地时区显示小时。

column2: The trace stores each duration as a nanosecond count.
column3: 追踪记录将每段时长保存为纳秒数。
column4: This display rounds to the nearest nanosecond.
column5: 这个显示结果会取整到最接近的纳秒。

column2: We report request latency in millisecond units.
column3: 我们以毫秒为单位报告请求延迟。
column4: The counter cannot show changes smaller than one millisecond.
column5: 这个计数器无法显示小于一毫秒的变化。

column2: Does the browser support this image format?
column3: 这个浏览器支持这种图片格式吗？
column4: We support the current release and the previous one.
column5: 我们支持当前版本和上一个版本。

column2: Who will maintain this package after the release?
column3: 发布后谁来维护这个软件包？
column4: We maintain a separate branch for security fixes.
column5: 我们维护着一个用于安全修复的独立分支。

column2: The service will be unavailable during maintenance.
column3: 维护期间服务会暂时不可用。
column4: Add the maintenance window to the status page.
column5: 把维护时段加到状态页面上。

column2: Back up the database before the upgrade.
column3: 升级前先备份数据库。
column4: Can we upgrade without changing the file format?
column5: 能在不改文件格式的情况下升级吗？

column2: The update fixes the login problem.
column3: 这次更新修复了登录问题。
column4: Do not update the screen after the component is removed.
column5: 组件移除后不要再更新界面。

column2: This tool can repair the damaged index.
column3: 这个工具能修复损坏的索引。
column4: Save a copy before attempting a repair.
column5: 尝试修复前先保存一份副本。

column2: The fix needs a test for the original failure.
column3: 这个修复需要用测试覆盖原来的故障。
column4: Can you fix the broken link on this page?
column5: 你能修复这个页面上的失效链接吗？

column2: We need to stabilize the build before adding features.
column3: 添加功能前，我们需要让构建稳定下来。
column4: These changes should help stabilize memory usage.
column5: 这些改动应该有助于稳定内存占用。

column2: The release plan includes a week for stabilization.
column3: 发布计划留出了一周做稳定化处理。
column4: During stabilization, we focus on bugs rather than new features.
column5: 稳定化期间，我们优先修缺陷，暂缓新增功能。

column2: The connection stays stable during the long upload.
column3: 长时间上传过程中，连接保持稳定。
column4: Keep the last stable build available for rollback.
column5: 保留上一个稳定构建，以便回滚。

column2: The nightly build is still unstable.
column3: 这个每日构建仍然不稳定。
column4: An unstable connection can interrupt the download.
column5: 不稳定的连接可能中断下载。

column2: The test checks stability over a full day.
column3: 这个测试会连续一天检查稳定性。
column4: We improved stability by limiting concurrent requests.
column5: 限制并发请求后，稳定性改善了。

column2: The beta release is ready for volunteer testing.
column3: 测试版已经准备好供志愿者试用。
column4: Keep beta feedback separate from production incidents.
column5: 把测试版反馈与生产环境事故分开记录。

column2: The alpha build includes an unfinished editor.
column3: 早期测试构建中包含一个尚未完成的编辑器。
column4: We use the alpha version to test the basic workflow.
column5: 我们用早期测试版本检查基本流程。

column2: The experimental feature is disabled by default.
column3: 这个实验性功能默认关闭。
column4: Mark the experimental API clearly in the documentation.
column5: 在文档中明确标注这个实验性接口。

column2: The prototype demonstrates the search interaction.
column3: 这个原型演示了搜索交互。
column4: We should test the prototype with actual users.
column5: 我们应该让真实用户测试这个原型。

column2: The preview shows unsaved changes.
column3: 预览会显示尚未保存的改动。
column4: Open the preview in a separate browser tab.
column5: 在单独的浏览器标签页中打开预览。

column2: The change has not reached production yet.
column3: 这个改动还没有部署到生产环境。
column4: Check production logs after the deployment.
column5: 部署后检查生产环境日志。

column2: A faster local build improves developer productivity.
column3: 更快的本地构建能提高开发效率。
column4: We measure productivity without counting lines of code.
column5: 我们衡量工作效率时，不用代码行数作标准。

column2: The shared test environment makes collaboration easier.
column3: 共享测试环境让协作更方便。
column4: Good collaboration includes explaining the reason for a change.
column5: 良好的协作包括说明改动原因。

column2: The editor supports collaborative document updates.
column3: 这个编辑器支持协作修改文档。
column4: We tested the collaborative workflow with two accounts.
column5: 我们用两个账户测试了协作流程。

column2: We collaborate with the design team on accessibility.
column3: 我们与设计团队合作改进无障碍体验。
column4: Can both users collaborate on the same draft?
column5: 两位用户能合作编辑同一份草稿吗？

column2: Please review the error handling before we merge.
column3: 合并前请审查错误处理逻辑。
column4: The review caught a missing access check.
column5: 代码审查发现了一处遗漏的访问权限检查。

column2: The reviewer asked for a smaller patch.
column3: 审查者希望把补丁拆小一点。
column4: Give the reviewer steps to reproduce the problem.
column5: 给审查者提供复现问题的步骤。

column2: The feedback points out a confusing error message.
column3: 反馈指出了一条难懂的错误提示。
column4: We need feedback from users with slower devices.
column5: 我们需要使用较慢设备的用户反馈。

column2: The release is waiting for final approval.
column3: 这次发布正在等待最终批准。
column4: Record the approval before deploying the change.
column5: 部署改动前，先记录批准结果。

column2: Do not approve the change until the tests pass.
column3: 测试通过前不要批准这个改动。
column4: Only the owner can approve this access request.
column5: 只有所有者能批准这个访问申请。
